posts.name: Deepak Rajan
posts.cooked:
I was under the impression that the BPTs weren’t mandatory. I was not able to find a copy of the grading handbook for the current semester, so ended up referring to the May 2023 one instead (May 2023 Grading document (Student).docx). I saw no mention of VMT (BPTs) being mandatory.

I got an email today saying that we have to attend 3 out of the 4 BPTs for OPPE eligibility. I am in a bit of a tight spot because I can see that OPPE is mandatory, but I haven’t attended the first two BPTs. Is there anything I can do to qualify for the OPPE? Also, where can I find the grading document for this semester? I don’t find it in my dashboard. It could be because I am retaking this course; I had previously taken this course in the last year.

Thanks in advance!

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Attending BPTs are required to be eligible for OPPE, and thus indirectly required for End Term.

Please refer to latest grading document for every term, since grading patterns change over time.

posts.name: Deepak Rajan
posts.cooked: Thanks for the response. Is there nothing I can do regarding this semester then? As mentioned in my message, I had no idea that these were mandatory. As I didn’t see the grading document in the dashboard (where I expected to see it), I assumed that nothing has changed.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
deepakrajan:

Is there nothing I can do regarding this semester then?

You can focus on the Quizzes and End Term. And attend the BPTs for practice. If ineligible for OPPE, then you can reattempt OPPE next term.

deepakrajan:

As I didn’t see the grading document in the dashboard (where I expected to see it), I assumed that nothing has changed.

There has been around 18 mails sent at the start of the term providing the link to student handbook and grading document for September term because students are expected to go through them each term for their subjects.

Screenshot 2024-11-10 at 1.36.56 PM1920×1188 157 KB

Screenshot 2024-11-10 at 1.40.47 PM1920×1057 133 KB

Further, there has been announcements about BPTs posted here on discourse and also sent in the course announcements in seek.

Please keep tabs on places like your email inbox, discourse, course inbox on seek, etc as this is an online degree and these are the only ways to disseminate information.

posts.name: Deepak Rajan
posts.cooked:
Noted, thank you. I’ll keep a keen eye on my emails from now on.

I’ll reattempt the OPPE next term and do the BPTs for practice as suggested, and primarily focus on the Quizzes and End term.

One last question: Will the OPPE reattempt count as a full course in terms of credit clearing capability (CCC)?
